releaseNotes:
• Fix: Blur overlay no longer blinks or flickers — ignores same-app popups/IME, avoids false scroll wipes & occlusion shrinkage, and applies deadband lock.
• Fix: Males no longer falsely blurred in Female-Only mode — tightened cross-gender NMS (IoU 0.60→0.28), added confidence-margin checks, gender-aware clustering, and opposite-gender box clamping.
• Fix: Internet now works in all browsers — VPN sends TCP RST for DoT (:853) & TCP DNS (:53), binds upstream DNS to physical network, adds ISP DNS priority, DoH fallback, and DNS cache.
